_help: Google Tag Manager + cookie consent bar (card SAG-44). container_id: the GTM container, like GTM-XXXXXXX; empty = GTM, the consent bar and the 'Cookie settings' links are all off. build.js writes the Consent Mode v2 defaults (everything denied) and the GTM loader at the top of <head> on the four pages (/, /en/, /brief, /en/brief), never in /admin. privacy_href: where the bar's privacy link goes, per language. privacy_page_ready: set true once those pages are published (silences the build warning). The bar's wording and the dataLayer events are in consent.js. After editing: node build.js, then deploy (with approval).
